responsibility: Implements initialization and semantic policy for gm2’s pervasive base environment. It creates the built-in modules, types, constants, functions, procedures, and exception symbols using GCC-derived type information, computes base-type min/max ranges, classifies ordinal/real/complex/math types, and enforces dialect-sensitive compatibility rules through large compatibility tables and checking routines used by later semantic passes and code generation.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of M2Base: it initializes the built-in modules, types, procedures, exceptions, and range metadata and enforces compatibility rules through concrete tables and checking routines. Unlike M2Base.def, it contains the actual symbol-table population and semantic policy machinery.
